qh: कौन सी पंचवर्षीय योजना 1978 में समाप्त कर दी गई थी?
e: The Fifth Five Year Plan (1974-79) was terminated a year early in 1978 by the Janata Party government. / जनता पार्टी की सरकार ने इसे समय से पहले ही बंद कर दिया था।

qe: The slogan 'Garibi Hatao' was part of which Five Year Plan?
qh: 'गरीबी हटाओ' का नारा किस पंचवर्षीय योजना का हिस्सा था?
e: It was the central theme of Indira Gandhi's campaign and the 5th Five Year Plan. / इंदिरा गांधी ने इस नारे को 5वीं योजना का मुख्य लक्ष्य बनाया था।

qe: Which Five Year Plan period was known as 'Plan Holiday'?
qh: किस पंचवर्षीय योजना की अवधि को 'प्लान हॉलिडे' कहा जाता है?
e: Plan Holiday occurred between the 3rd and 4th plans due to wars and economic crisis. / युद्ध और सूखे के कारण 3 साल तक कोई लंबी योजना नहीं बनी, उसे 'हॉलिडे' कहा गया।

qe: Which Five Year Plan gave importance to 'Human Resource Development'?
qh: किस पंचवर्षीय योजना ने 'मानव संसाधन विकास' को महत्व दिया?
e: The 8th Plan (1992-97) focused on education, health, and employment as key pillars. / आठवीं योजना में इंसानों की शिक्षा और स्वास्थ्य को देश की तरक्की का आधार माना गया।

qe: During which plan was 'NABARD' established?
qh: 'नाबार्ड' की स्थापना किस योजना के दौरान हुई थी?
e: Established in 1982 during the 6th Plan for rural development. / ग्रामीण विकास के लिए छठी योजना में नाबार्ड बनाया गया था।

qe: Which Five Year Plan was based on the 'Mahalanobis Model'?
qh: कौन सी पंचवर्षीय योजना 'महालनोबिस मॉडल' पर आधारित थी?
e: Focused on heavy industrialization and basic industries. / इसमें बड़े उद्योगों को विकसित करने पर जोर दिया गया था।

qe: The 'Tenth Five Year Plan' target for poverty reduction was:
qh: दसवीं योजना में गरीबी कम करने का लक्ष्य क्या था?
o: Reduce by 5 percentage points | 5 प्रतिशत अंक कम करना
e: Focus was on doubling per capita income and reducing poverty. / इसका लक्ष्य गरीबी को तेजी से घटाना और कमाई बढ़ाना था।

qe: Which body was responsible for giving 'Final Approval' to the Five Year Plans in India?
qh: भारत में पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं को 'अंतिम स्वीकृति' देने के लिए कौन सा निकाय जिम्मेदार था?
o: National Development Council (NDC) | राष्ट्रीय विकास परिषद
e: The NDC, chaired by the PM and including CMs of all states, was the final authority to approve the draft of Five Year Plans. / योजना आयोग योजना बनाता था, लेकिन उसे अंतिम मंजूरी NDC देती थी।

qe: During which Five Year Plan was the 'Twenty Point Programme' (TPP) first launched?
qh: 'बीस सूत्री कार्यक्रम' (TPP) पहली बार किस पंचवर्षीय योजना के दौरान शुरू किया गया था?
e: Launched in 1975 by Indira Gandhi, the TPP aimed at poverty eradication and improving the quality of life in rural areas. / गरीबी दूर करने और ग्रामीण जीवन सुधारने के लिए 1975 में यह कार्यक्रम शुरू हुआ था।

qe: Who was the 'Deputy Chairman' of the first Planning Commission of India?
qh: भारत के पहले योजना आयोग के 'उपाध्यक्ष' कौन थे?
e: While the PM was the Chairman, Gulzarilal Nanda served as the first Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission. / नेहरू जी अध्यक्ष थे और गुलजारीलाल नंदा उपाध्यक्ष बनाए गए थे।

qe: Which Five Year Plan was terminated a year early in 1978?
qh: कौन सी पंचवर्षीय योजना 1978 में एक साल पहले समाप्त कर दी गई थी?
e: The Fifth Plan (1974-79) was terminated in 1978 by the new Janata Party government. / जनता पार्टी की सरकार ने आते ही पांचवीं योजना को समय से पहले बंद कर दिया था।

qe: Which Five Year Plan focused on 'Faster, More Inclusive and Sustainable Growth'?
qh: 'तीव्र, अधिक समावेशी और सतत विकास' किस पंचवर्षीय योजना का नारा था?
e: The 12th Plan (2012-17) was the last five year plan of India with this inclusive focus. / 12वीं योजना का मुख्य लक्ष्य विकास को सबके लिए और पर्यावरण के अनुकूल बनाना था।

qe: During which Five Year Plan was the 'Steel Plant at Bokaro' established?
qh: 'बोकारो स्टील प्लांट' की स्थापना किस पंचवर्षीय योजना के दौरान हुई थी?
e: Established with Soviet assistance, the Bokaro Steel Plant was initiated during the 3rd Plan period. / रूस की मदद से तीसरी योजना के दौरान बोकारो में इस्पात कारखाने की शुरुआत हुई थी।

qe: Which Five Year Plan focused on 'Industrialization' (Mahalanobis Model)?
qh: 'औद्योगीकरण' पर किस पंचवर्षीय योजना ने ध्यान केंद्रित किया था?
e: Revision-proof point: It prioritized heavy industries like Steel and Power. / इसमें देश को औद्योगिक रूप से मजबूत बनाने का लक्ष्य रखा गया था।

qe: The concept of 'Demographic Dividend' for India refers to:
qh: भारत के लिए 'जनसांख्यिकीय लाभांश' (Demographic Dividend) की अवधारणा का तात्पर्य है:
o: A tax paid by the youth
The economic growth potential resulting from a large share of the working-age population
A decrease in the number of schools
Increasing the retirement age to 80 years
e: India has a high percentage of young people (under 35), which can drive economic growth if provided with proper education and skills. / भारत में युवाओं का प्रतिशत अधिक है, जो उचित शिक्षा और कौशल प्रदान किए जाने पर आर्थिक विकास को गति दे सकते हैं।

qe: What was the significance of the 1991 reforms in India regarding its global economic position?
qh: भारत की वैश्विक आर्थिक स्थिति के संबंध में 1991 के सुधारों का क्या महत्व था?
o: India transitioned from an inward-looking economy to an open, globalized one
India banned the use of the Internet
e: The 1991 reforms (LPG) allowed India to integrate with the global economy, attracting foreign investment and expanding trade. / 1991 के सुधारों (एलपीजी) ने भारत को विदेशी निवेश आकर्षित करने और व्यापार का विस्तार करने की अनुमति दी।

qe: What is the primary difference between 'First Generation' and 'Second Generation' economic reforms?
qh: 'प्रथम पीढ़ी' और 'द्वितीय पीढ़ी' के आर्थिक सुधारों के बीच प्राथमिक अंतर क्या है?
o: First generation was for agriculture; Second was for space
First generation focused on macro-stability (LPG); Second focuses on structural/social sectors like education and health
First generation was only for state governments
e: First generation reforms (1991) aimed at opening the economy (Liberalization, Privatization, Globalization), while second generation reforms target deeper institutional changes and human development. / प्रथम पीढ़ी के सुधारों ने अर्थव्यवस्था को खोलने पर ध्यान दिया, जबकि द्वितीय पीढ़ी के सुधार संस्थागत परिवर्तनों और मानव विकास पर केंद्रित हैं।

qe: Who is the Chairman of the 'State Finance Commission' in Bihar?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Ye ek Constitutional body hai (Art 243-I). Student yahan 'Non-Constitutional' ke set mein confuse ho sakte hain. \n2. Reminder: Har 5 saal mein iska gathan hota hai.

qe: Which body ensures that 'Electoral Malpractices' are reported to the President?
e: 1. Note: ECI ek constitutional body hai, par iska hustle non-constitutional bodies ke sath milkar hota hai investigation mein.

qe: Who is the Chairman of the 'Inter-State Council'?
e: 1. Catch: Ye ek CONSTITUTIONAL body hai (Art 263). Student yahan 'Non-Constitutional' mein confuse hote hain.

qe: Which Article gives 'Constitutional Status' to Municipalities?
qh: नगर पालिकाओं को 'संवैधानिक दर्जा' कौन सा अनुच्छेद देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Local Govt. \\n2. Logic: 74th Amendment se ise Part IXA mein joda gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Bihar mein Patna Municipal Corporation (PMC) sabse purani hai.

qe: The 'Directive Principles of State Policy' (DPSP) are borrowed from the constitution of?
qh: 'राज्य के नीति निर्देशक तत्व' (DPSP) किस देश के संविधान से लिए गए हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: DPSP sarkar ke liye 'Guidelines' hain. \\n2. Logic: Humne ye Ireland se liya, aur Ireland ne ise Spain se liya tha. \\n3. Extra Fact: Inka maksad India ko ek 'Welfare State' (Kalyankari Rajya) banana hai.

qe: What is the main difference between Fundamental Rights and DPSP?
qh: मौलिक अधिकारों और DPSP के बीच मुख्य अंतर क्या है?
o: Rights are for rich, DPSP for poor
Rights are justiciable, DPSP are non-justiciable (अधिकार न्यायोचित हैं, DPSP नहीं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Enforcement ki taqat. \\n2. Logic: Agar Rights chhinein toh aap Court ja sakte hain (Justiciable), par agar DPSP lagu na ho toh aap Court nahi ja sakte (Non-justiciable). \\n3. Extra Fact: Halanki Article 37 kehta hai ki DPSP desh ke governance mein 'Fundamental' (Mool) hain.

qe: Article 44 of the Indian Constitution provides for:
qh: भारतीय संविधान का अनुच्छेद 44 किसके लिए प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ek desh, ek kanoon (Personal Laws ke liye). \\n2. Logic: Iska matlab hai ki dharam ke bajaye desh ka ek hi kanoon hona chahiye shaadi, talaq aur jaydad ke liye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Goa India ka akela aisa state hai jahan UCC lagu hai.

qe: The 'Fundamental Duties' were added to the Constitution by which Amendment?
qh: 'मौलिक कर्तव्य' किस संशोधन द्वारा संविधान में जोड़े गए थे?
e: 1. Core Concept: Nagriko ki zimmedari. \\n2. Logic: 1976 mein Emergency ke waqt Swaran Singh Committee ki recommendation par Part IVA (Art 51A) joda gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Shuruat mein 10 duties thi, ab total 11 hain.

qe: Article 39A provides for 'Free Legal Aid'. It was added by:
qh: अनुच्छेद 39A 'मुफ्त कानूनी सहायता' प्रदान करता है। इसे किसके द्वारा जोड़ा गया था?
e: 1. Core Concept: Garibo ko nyay milna chahiye. \\n2. Logic: Paiso ki kami ki wajah se kisi ka nyay na ruke, isliye sarkar ko muft vakeel dene ka nirdesh diya gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isi Article ke tehat 'NALSA' jaisi sansthayein kaam karti hain.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Separation of Judiciary from Executive'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'कार्यपालिका से न्यायपालिका के अलगाव' का प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Independence of Courts. \\n2. Logic: Faisla sunane wala (Judge) aur kanoon lagu karne wala (Police/DM) alag-alag hone chahiye taaki bhedbhav na ho. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Fair Trial' ki pehli shart hai.

qe: The 11th Fundamental Duty (Education for children) was added by:
qh: 11वां मौलिक कर्तव्य (बच्चों की शिक्षा) किसके द्वारा जोड़ा गया था?
e: 1. Core Concept: Parents ki zimmedari. \\n2. Logic: 2002 mein jab RTE (Art 21A) bana, tabhi 11th duty jodi gayi ki parents apne 6-14 saal ke bacchon ko school bhejein. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye duty aur mool adhikar ek hi coin ke do pehlu hain.

qe: Article 45 provides for Early Childhood Care for children below what age?
qh: अनुच्छेद 45 किस उम्र से कम के बच्चों के लिए प्रारंभिक बचपन की देखभाल का प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Anganwadi aur Pre-schooling. \\n2. Logic: Pehle ye 14 saal tak tha, par 86th Amendment ke baad ise 6 saal tak ke bacchon ke liye kar diya gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: 6-14 saal ab Article 21A (Fundamental Right) mein aata hai.

qe: Which Article deals with the 'Promotion of International Peace and Security'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय शांति और सुरक्षा को बढ़ावा देने' से संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: India ki Foreign Policy ka base. \\n2. Logic: India hamesha shanti ka samarthak raha hai, ye Article sarkar ko dusre desho ke sath ache rishte rakhne ka nirdesh deta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye DPSP ka sabse aakhri Article hai.

qe: Fundamental Duties apply to both Citizens and Foreigners. True or False?
qh: मौलिक कर्तव्य नागरिकों और विदेशियों दोनों पर लागू होते हैं। सही या गलत?
e: 1. Core Concept: Citizenship ki zimmedari. \\n2. Logic: Fundamental Rights sabko mil sakte hain, par 'Duties' sirf un par lagu hoti hain jo Bharat ke nagrik hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Foreigners se hum unke desh ke prati wafa-dari ki ummid nahi kar sakte.

qe: Article 43B is related to the promotion of:
qh: अनुच्छेद 43B किसके प्रचार/बढ़ावा देने से संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Rural development aur teamwork. \\n2. Logic: Ise 97th Amendment (2011) se joda gaya taaki log milkar business (jaise Amul) kar sakein. \\n3. Extra Fact: Cooperative societies banana ab ek Fundamental Right bhi hai (Art 19).

qe: Which DPSP is based on 'Liberal-Intellectual' principles?
qh: कौन सा DPSP 'उदार-बौद्धिक' सिद्धांतों पर आधारित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Modern thoughts. \\n2. Logic: UCC (Art 44) aur Agriculture ka modernization (Art 48) liberal thoughts ka hissa hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: DPSP ko teen hisso mein banta gaya hai: Socialist, Gandhian aur Liberal.

qe: Article 47 of the Constitution is related to:
qh: संविधान का अनुच्छेद 47 किससे संबंधित है?
o: Nutrition and Standard of Living (पोषण और जीवन स्तर)
e: 1. Core Concept: Public Health. \\n2. Logic: Sarkar ka farz hai ki wo logon ka nutrition badhaye aur zeherili chizon (Alcohol/Drugs) par rok lagaye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Bihar mein Sharab-bandi (Liquor Ban) isi Article ke logic par ki gayi hai.

qe: What is the 10th Fundamental Duty?
qh: 10वां मौलिक कर्तव्य क्या है?
o: To strive towards excellence (उत्कृष्टता की ओर बढ़ना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Desh ki tarakki. \\n2. Logic: Har nagrik ko apne field mein best kaam karna chahiye taaki desh upar uth sake. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye duty har student aur working professional ke liye sabse important hai.

qe: Directive Principles are 'Enforceable' by the court in special cases.
qh: नीति निर्देशक तत्व विशेष मामलों में अदालत द्वारा 'प्रवर्तनीय' हैं।
e: 1. Core Concept: Non-enforceability. \\n2. Logic: Kisi bhi case mein aap sarkar ko DPSP ke liye court mein nahi ghaseet sakte. \\n3. Extra Fact: Agar sarkar DPSP follow nahi karti, toh 'Janata' use agle election mein saza deti hai.

qe: Article 39(d) ensures 'Equal pay for equal work' for:
qh: अनुच्छेद 39(d) 'समान काम के लिए समान वेतन' सुनिश्चित करता है:
o: Both Men and Women (पुरुष और महिला दोनों)
e: 1. Core Concept: Economic Equality. \\n2. Logic: Gender ke adhar par salary mein bhedbhav nahi hona chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye socialist principle ka sabse bada example hai.

qe: Which Article protects 'Monuments and Places of National Importance'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'स्मारकों और राष्ट्रीय महत्व के स्थानों' की रक्षा करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Cultural Heritage. \\n2. Logic: Taj Mahal, Red Fort jaisi jagaho ko ganda hone ya tootne se bachana sarkar ki zimmedari hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Fundamental Duties mein bhi nagriko ko ise bachane ko kaha gaya hai.

qe: Fundamental Duties are 'Non-justiciable' in nature.
qh: मौलिक कर्तव्य प्रकृति में 'गैर-न्यायोचित' हैं।
e: 1. Core Concept: Legal enforcement. \\n2. Logic: DPSP ki tarah, Duties ke liye bhi direct saza nahi hai, jab tak Sansad koi kanoon (jaise Flag Code) na bana de. \\n3. Extra Fact: Verma Committee ne kuch duties ko kanooni roop dene ki baat ki thi.

qe: Which Article of the Constitution is known as the 'Socialist Pillar' of DPSP?
qh: संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद को DPSP का 'समाजवादी स्तंभ' कहा जाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Social aur Economic Justice. \\n2. Logic: Article 38 kehta hai ki State ko aisi samajik vyavastha banani chahiye jahan sabko nyay mile aur 'Income Inequality' kam ho. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Article Preamble ke 'Socialist' word ko real meaning deta hai.

qe: The 'Separation of Judiciary from Executive' (Art 50) is necessary because:
qh: 'कार्यपालिका से न्यायपालिका का अलगाव' क्यों आवश्यक है?
o: To ensure impartiality of Justice (न्याय की निष्पक्षता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए)
e: 1. Core Concept: Independence of Judiciary. \\n2. Logic: Agar kanoon banane wala hi saza sunayega, toh faisla hamesha sarkar ke paksh mein hoga. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 50 loktantra ke 'Checks and Balances' ka ek mukhya hissa hai.

qe: Which Fundamental Duty was added to safeguard 'Public Property'?
qh: 'सार्वजनिक संपत्ति' की रक्षा के लिए कौन सा मौलिक कर्तव्य जोड़ा गया?
e: 1. Core Concept: Desh ki sampatti ko nuksan na pahunchana. \\n2. Logic: Dange ya virodh ke waqt bus, train ya sarkari building todna is duty ka violation hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme 'Abjure Violence' (hinsa se dur rehna) bhi shamil hai.

qe: Article 43A deals with 'Participation of workers in management of industries'. It was added by:
qh: अनुच्छेद 43A उद्योगों के प्रबंधन में श्रमिकों की भागीदारी से संबंधित है। इसे जोड़ा गया था:
e: 1. Core Concept: Workers' Rights in Industry. \\n2. Logic: Mazdooron ko sirf kaam karne wala na mana jaye, balki unhe management ke faislo mein bhi jagah mile. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye ek Socialist principle hai jo industrial democracy ko badhava deta hai.

qe: What is the status of 'Fundamental Duties' if someone violates them?
qh: यदि कोई मौलिक कर्तव्यों का उल्लंघन करता है, तो उनकी स्थिति क्या है?
o: No direct legal penalty (कोई प्रत्यक्ष कानूनी दंड नहीं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Non-enforceable nature. \\n2. Logic: Duties 'Morally binding' hain par 'Legally' nahi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Halanki, agar koi duty 'Flag Code' ya 'Wildlife Act' ke andar aati hai, toh kanoon ke tehat saza mil sakti hai.

qe: Article 48 deals with 'Organization of Agriculture and Animal Husbandry'. What does it prohibit?
qh: अनुच्छेद 48 कृषि और पशुपालन के संगठन से संबंधित है। यह किस पर रोक लगाता है?
o: Slaughter of cows and calves (गाय और बछड़ों का वध)
e: 1. Core Concept: Gandhian aur Modern Animal Husbandry. \\n2. Logic: Ye Article dudharu pashuo ki nasl sudharne aur unki hatya rokne ka nirdesh deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Kayi states mein 'Cow Slaughter Ban' isi Article ke adhar par banaya gaya hai.

qe: The 'Directives' mentioned in Article 39(b) and 39(c) are unique because:
qh: अनुच्छेद 39(b) और 39(c) में दिए गए निर्देश अद्वितीय हैं क्योंकि:
o: They can prevail over Fundamental Rights in some cases (कुछ मामलों में मौलिक अधिकारों पर हावी हो सकते हैं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Conflict between Part III and Part IV. \\n2. Logic: Article 31C kehta hai ki agar sarkar wealth distribute (Art 39b, c) karne ke liye kanoon banaye, toh use Art 14 aur 19 ke violation par radd nahi kiya jayega. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye social justice lane ka sabse bada kanooni hathiyar hai.

qe: Which Fundamental Duty is about 'Scientific Temper' and 'Inquiry'?
qh: कौन सा मौलिक कर्तव्य 'वैज्ञानिक दृष्टिकोण' और 'जांच' के बारे में है?
o: To develop scientific temper, humanism and spirit of inquiry (वैज्ञानिक दृष्टिकोण, मानवतावाद और जांच की भावना विकसित करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Modern Thinking. \\n2. Logic: Nagriko ko andh-vishwas chhod kar logic aur science par bharosa karna chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye duty India ko ek progressive society banane mein madad karti hai.

qe: Article 41 provides 'Right to Work and Education' in which cases?
qh: अनुच्छेद 41 किन मामलों में 'काम और शिक्षा का अधिकार' प्रदान करता है?
o: In cases of unemployment, old age, and sickness (बेरोजगारी, बुढ़ापे और बीमारी के मामलों में)
e: 1. Core Concept: Social Security. \\n2. Logic: Jo log majboor hain, sarkar unhe kaam (jaise MNREGA) aur pension ki suvidha degi. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Old Age Pension' schemes isi Article ke vision par chalti hain.

qe: Fundamental Duties were added based on the recommendation of which committee?
qh: किसकी सिफारिश पर मौलिक कर्तव्य जोड़े गए थे?
e: 1. Core Concept: 1976 ki historical recommendation. \\n2. Logic: Committee ne 8 duties sujhayi thi, par 10 jodi gayi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Shuruat mein inka zikr 'Part IVA' ke ek hi Article 51A mein kiya gaya.

qe: Article 36 defines 'The State'. Is it the same as Article 12?
qh: अनुच्छेद 36 'राज्य' को परिभाषित करता है। क्या यह अनुच्छेद 12 के समान है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Definition of State. \\n2. Logic: Jo 'State' Fundamental Rights lagu karne ke liye zimmedar hai, wahi DPSP lagu karne ke liye bhi zimmedar hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme Parliament, Assemblies aur Local bodies sab shamil hain.

qe: The duty to 'Uphold and protect the Sovereignty, Unity and Integrity of India' is:
qh: 'भारत की संप्रभुता, एकता और अखंडता को बनाए रखना और उसकी रक्षा करना' कर्तव्य है:
e: 1. Core Concept: Desh ki ekta. \\n2. Logic: Har nagrik ka farz hai ki wo aisa kaam na kare jisse desh toote. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye duty 'Integrity' shabd ke sath aur bhi mazboot ho gayi hai.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Just and Humane conditions of work' and 'Maternity Relief'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'काम की न्यायसंगत और मानवीय स्थिति' और 'प्रसूति सहायता' का प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Labor and Women Welfare. \\n2. Logic: Jahan log kaam karein wahan ki haalat achi ho, aur mahilaon ko maternity leave mile. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Maternity Benefit Act' isi Article ko pura karne ke liye banaya gaya hai.

qe: Fundamental Duties are mentioned in which part of the Constitution?
qh: मौलिक कर्तव्यों का उल्लेख संविधान के किस भाग में है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Added part. \\n2. Logic: Inhe baad mein joda gaya isliye 'Part IV' ke sath 'A' lagaya gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme keval ek Article hai—Article 51A.

qe: Article 46 directs the State to promote the educational and economic interests of:
qh: अनुच्छेद 46 राज्य को किसके शैक्षिक और आर्थिक हितों को बढ़ावा देने का निर्देश देता है?
o: SC, ST and other weaker sections (SC, ST और अन्य कमजोर वर्ग)
e: 1. Core Concept: Social Upliftment. \\n2. Logic: Jo varg pichde hain, unhe upar lane ke liye sarkar ko special schemes (Scholarships etc.) chalani chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Social Justice' ka mukhya dhaar hai.

qe: Which Fundamental Duty is about 'Protecting the Natural Environment'?
qh: कौन सा मौलिक कर्तव्य 'प्राकृतिक पर्यावरण की रक्षा' के बारे में है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ecology protection. \\n2. Logic: Jungle, jheel aur nadiyon ko bachana humari zimmedari hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: DPSP mein Article 48A bhi yahi baat kehta hai (Sarkar ke liye).

qe: Article 43 provides for 'Living Wage' for workers. What is a 'Living Wage'?
qh: अनुच्छेद 43 श्रमिकों के लिए 'निर्वाह मजदूरी' का प्रावधान करता है। 'निर्वाह मजदूरी' क्या है?
o: Enough for food, clothing, health and education (भोजन, कपड़ा, स्वास्थ्य और शिक्षा के लिए पर्याप्त)
e: 1. Core Concept: Decent standard of living. \\n2. Logic: Mazdoori itni ho ki ek insaan ijjat se apni aur parivar ki basic jaruratein puri kar sake. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Minimum Wage' se thoda upar ka concept hai.

qe: How many Fundamental Duties were added in 1976?
qh: 1976 में कितने मौलिक कर्तव्य जोड़े गए थे?
e: 1. Core Concept: Original addition. \\n2. Logic: 42nd Amendment ne 10 duties jodi thi. \\n3. Extra Fact: 11th duty (Education) bahut baad mein 2002 mein jodi gayi.

qe: Which Article says DPSP are 'Fundamental in the governance of the country'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद कहता है कि DPSP 'देश के शासन में मौलिक' हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Importance of DPSP. \\n2. Logic: Bhale hi Court inpar action na le sake, par sarkar kanoon banate waqt inka dhyan rakhne ke liye 'Duty-bound' hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye kanoon banate waqt sarkar ke liye 'Moral Compass' ka kaam karte hain.

qe: The duty to 'Safeguard Public Property and Abjure Violence' is:
qh: 'सार्वजनिक संपत्ति की रक्षा करना और हिंसा का त्याग करना' कर्तव्य है:
e: 1. Core Concept: Non-violence in public life. \\n2. Logic: Loktantra mein hinsa ki koi jagah nahi hai, isliye ise duty banaya gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye duty aaj ke 'Protest Culture' mein sabse zaroori hai.

qe: Article 39(f) directs the State to protect children against:
qh: अनुच्छेद 39(f) राज्य को बच्चों की किससे रक्षा करने का निर्देश देता है?
o: Exploitation and Moral abandonment (शोषण और नैतिक परित्याग)
e: 1. Core Concept: Child Welfare. \\n2. Logic: Bacchon ko azadi aur samman ke sath vikas ke mauke milein. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 42nd Amendment se update kiya gaya tha.

qe: What is the 11th Fundamental Duty about?
qh: 11वां मौलिक कर्तव्य किसके बारे में है?
o: Providing education to children aged 6-14 (6-14 वर्ष के बच्चों को शिक्षा प्रदान करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Parental responsibility. \\n2. Logic: Sarkar school banayegi, par parents ka farz hai ki wo bacchon ko school bhejein. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 86th Amendment Act, 2002 se laya gaya.

qe: Which DPSP is based on 'Gandhian' ideology?
qh: कौन सा DPSP 'गांधीवादी' विचारधारा पर आधारित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Rural self-reliance. \\n2. Logic: Gandhi ji 'Cottage Industries' (chote udyog) ko badhava dena chahte the taaki gaon amir banein. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 40 (Panchayat) aur 47 (Liquor ban) bhi Gandhian hain.

qe: The duty to 'Protect and improve the natural environment' includes:
qh: 'प्राकृतिक पर्यावरण की रक्षा और सुधार' के कर्तव्य में शामिल हैं:
o: Forests, Lakes, Rivers and Wildlife (वन, झीलें, नदियाँ और वन्यजीव)
e: 1. Core Concept: Environmental awareness. \\n2. Logic: Ye sabhi kudrati resources desh ki sampatti hain aur nagriko ko inka dhyan rakhna chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme 'Compassion for living creatures' (jaanwaro ke prati daya) bhi likha hai.

qe: Article 39(a) ensures the right to an adequate means of 'Livelihood' for:
qh: अनुच्छेद 39(a) किसके लिए 'आजीविका' के पर्याप्त साधनों का अधिकार सुनिश्चित करता है?
o: All Citizens equally (सभी नागरिकों को समान रूप से)
e: 1. Core Concept: Economic Justice. \\n2. Logic: Har nagrik ko kamane aur apna pet bharne ka barabar adhikar milna chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye socialist principle ka base hai.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Uniform Civil Code' as a target?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'समान नागरिक संहिता' को एक लक्ष्य के रूप में प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legal Uniformity. \\n2. Logic: Poore desh mein shaadi, talaq aur viraasat ke kanoon ek jaise hone chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Liberal-Intellectual' principle mana jata hai.

qe: The duty to 'Cherish and follow the noble ideals of the freedom struggle' is:
qh: 'स्वतंत्रता संग्राम के महान आदर्शों को संजोना और उनका पालन करना' कर्तव्य है:
e: 1. Core Concept: Patriotism. \\n2. Logic: Jin adarsho ke liye humare krantikari lade, unhe hamesha yaad rakhna chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye duty nagriko mein desh-bhakti ki bhavna jagaye rakhti hai.

qe: Which Article deals with the 'Promotion of Cottage Industries'?
qh: 'कुटीर उद्योगों के प्रचार' से कौन सा अनुच्छेद संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Rural Economy. \\n2. Logic: Gaon mein chote-chote udyog lagane se berojgari khatam hogi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye ek mukhya Gandhian principle hai.

qe: Fundamental Duties are 'Statutory' duties. What does this mean?
qh: मौलिक कर्तव्य 'साविधिक' (Statutory) कर्तव्य हैं। इसका क्या अर्थ है?
o: Parliament can enforce them by making laws (संसद कानून बनाकर उन्हें लागू कर सकती है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Indirect Enforcement. \\n2. Logic: Bhale hi Samvidhan saza na de, par Sansad 'Forest Act' ya 'Flag Code' banakar inka palan karwa sakti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Verma Committee ne isi point par zor diya tha.

qe: Article 38(2) aims to minimize inequalities in:
qh: अनुच्छेद 38(2) किसमें असमानताओं को कम करने का लक्ष्य रखता है?
o: Income, Status, Facilities and Opportunities (आय, स्थिति, सुविधाएं और अवसर)
e: 1. Core Concept: Social Equality. \\n2. Logic: Sirf paisa nahi, balki status aur suvidhao mein bhi bhedbhav khatam hona chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 44th Amendment Act (1978) se joda gaya tha.

qe: Article 48A (Environment Protection) was added by which amendment?
qh: अनुच्छेद 48A (पर्यावरण संरक्षण) किस संशोधन द्वारा जोड़ा गया था?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ecology aur Wildlife. \\n2. Logic: 1976 mein desh ko ehsas hua ki jungle aur jaanwaro ko bachana zaroori hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Wildlife Protection Act isi vision ka hissa hai.

qe: Which Constitutional Amendment reduced the voting age from 21 to 18?
qh: किस संविधान संशोधन ने मतदान की आयु 21 से घटाकर 18 कर दी?
e: The 61st Amendment (1988) changed Article 326. / 61वें संशोधन (1988) ने अनुच्छेद 326 में बदलाव किया।

qe: Who was the first female Governor of an Indian state?
qh: भारतीय राज्य की पहली महिला राज्यपाल कौन थीं?
e: She served as the Governor of Uttar Pradesh. / उन्होंने उत्तर प्रदेश की राज्यपाल के रूप में कार्य किया।

qe: Which Amendment Act is known as the 'Mini Constitution' of India?
qh: किस संशोधन अधिनियम को भारत का 'लघु संविधान' कहा जाता है?
e: The 42.nd Amendment (1976) brought massive changes to the Constitution. / 42वें संशोधन (1976) ने संविधान में व्यापक बदलाव किए थे।

qe: The 'Directive Principles of State Policy' (DPSP) are borrowed from:
qh: 'राज्य के नीति निर्देशक तत्व' (DPSP) कहाँ से लिए गए हैं?
e: DPSPs are mentioned in Part IV (Articles 36-51). / DPSP का उल्लेख भाग IV (अनुच्छेद 36-51) में है।

qe: The 'Fundamental Duties' were added to the Constitution on whose recommendation?
qh: 'मौलिक कर्तव्य' किसकी सिफारिश पर संविधान में जोड़े गए थे?
e: They were added by the 42nd Amendment in 1976. / इन्हें 1976 में 42वें संशोधन द्वारा जोड़ा गया था।

qe: Who appoints the 'Governor' of a State in India?
qh: भारत में किसी राज्य के 'राज्यपाल' की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
e: The Governor holds office during the pleasure of the President. / राज्यपाल राष्ट्रपति के प्रसादपर्यंत पद धारण करता है।

qe: Which part of the Constitution deals with 'Citizenship'?
qh: संविधान का कौन सा भाग 'नागरिकता' से संबंधित है?
e: Articles 5 to 11 in Part II deal with citizenship. / भाग II के अनुच्छेद 5 से 11 नागरिकता से संबंधित हैं।

qe: The idea of 'Single Citizenship' is taken from which country?
qh: 'एकल नागरिकता' का विचार किस देश से लिया गया है?
e: Unlike USA, India follows single citizenship for all states. / अमेरिका के विपरीत, भारत सभी राज्यों के लिए एकल नागरिकता का पालन करता है।

qe: Which Schedule contains the 'Anti-Defection Law'?
qh: किस अनुसूची में 'दलबदल विरोधी कानून' शामिल है?
e: It was added by the 52nd Amendment Act, 1985. / इसे 1985 के 52वें संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा जोड़ा गया था।

qe: Economic planning is in which list of the Indian Constitution?
qh: आर्थिक नियोजन भारतीय संविधान की किस सूची में है?
e: Both Central and State governments can make laws on economic planning. / केंद्र और राज्य दोनों सरकारें आर्थिक नियोजन पर कानून बना सकती हैं।

qe: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides for the 'Finance Commission'?
e: Article 280 of the Indian Constitution states that the President shall constitute a Finance Commission every five years.

qe: Which part of the Indian Constitution deals with the Fundamental Rights?
e: Part III (Articles 12 to 35) is known as the Magna Carta of India.

qe: The idea of 'Directive Principles of State Policy' was borrowed from which country?
e: DPSPs are borrowed from the Irish Constitution (Article 45).

qe: Who is known as the 'Architect of the Indian Constitution'?
e: Dr. Ambedkar was the chairman of the Drafting Committee.

qe: What is the minimum age required to become the President of India?
e: According to Article 58, a person must be at least 35 years old.

qe: Which Fundamental Right was described by Dr. Ambedkar as the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution?
e: Article 32 allows citizens to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of rights.

qe: The 'Panchayati Raj' system was first inaugurated in which state?
e: It was first started in Nagaur, Rajasthan on Oct 2, 1959.

qe: How many schedules were there in the original Constitution of India?
e: Originally there were 8 schedules; currently, there are 12.

qe: Who appoints the Chief Justice of India?
e: The President appoints the CJI under Article 124(2).

qe: The 42nd Amendment Act (1976) added which words to the Preamble?
e: These three words were added during the Emergency period.

qe: Which article deals with the 'Right to Education'?
e: Article 21A makes free and compulsory education a fundamental right for ages 6-14.

qe: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of?
e: Under Article 64, the VP presides over the Rajya Sabha.

qe: Who has the power to call a 'Joint Sitting' of both Houses of Parliament?
e: The President calls the joint sitting (Art 108), but the Speaker presides over it.

qe: Which Article of the Constitution is related to 'Money Bill'?
e: Article 110 defines the Money Bill, which can only be introduced in Lok Sabha.

qe: What is the maximum strength of the Lok Sabha as per the Constitution?
e: The maximum strength is 552 (530 from States, 20 from UTs, 2 nominated).

qe: In India, the concept of 'Single Citizenship' is adopted from?
e: Unlike the USA (dual citizenship), India follows the British model of single citizenship.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Election Commission' of India?
e: Article 324 gives the EC power of superintendence, direction, and control of elections.

qe: Who was the first speaker of the Lok Sabha?
e: Ganesh Vasudev Mavalankar served as the first Speaker from 1952-1956.

qe: The 'Fundamental Duties' were added to the Constitution on the recommendation of?
e: They were added by the 42nd Amendment in 1976 based on this committee's report.

qe: Who administers the oath of office to the President of India?
e: In the absence of the CJI, the senior-most judge of the Supreme Court performs this duty.

qe: Which Article is related to the 'Uniform Civil Code'?
e: Article 44 (DPSP) states that the State shall endeavor to secure a UCC for all citizens.

qe: Who participates in the 'Electoral College' for the election of the President?
qh: राष्ट्रपति के चुनाव के लिए 'निर्वाचक मंडल' में कौन शामिल होता है?
o: Elected members of Parliament and State Assemblies (संसद और विधानसभाओं के निर्वाचित सदस्य)
e: 1. Core Concept: President ka election 'Indirect' hota hai. \\n2. Logic: Sirf 'Elected' (Chune hue) log hi vote dete hain. Nominated members (jo President khud chunta hai) vote nahi de sakte taaki bhedbhav na ho. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme Delhi aur Puducherry ki assemblies ke elected members bhi shamil hain (70th Amendment).

qe: Which Article allows the President to grant 'Pardon' (क्षमादान)?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति को 'क्षमादान' देने की अनुमति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Power of President. \\n2. Logic: Agar court ne kisi ko saza di hai, toh President use kam ya khatam kar sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: President 'Death Sentence' (fansi) ko poori tarah maaf kar sakte hain, jo power Governor ke paas nahi hai.

qe: What is the 'Impeachment' (महाभियोग) of the President under Article 61?
qh: अनुच्छेद 61 के तहत राष्ट्रपति का 'महाभियोग' क्या है?
o: Process to remove President (हटाने की प्रक्रिया)
e: 1. Core Concept: Removal on 'Violation of Constitution'. \\n2. Logic: Agar President Samvidhan todte hain, toh Parliament unhe hata sakti hai. Ye process kisi bhi house (LS ya RS) mein shuru ho sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Aaj tak India mein kisi bhi President par impeachment nahi chala hai.

qe: The 'Ordinance-making power' (अध्यादेश) of the President is under which Article?
qh: राष्ट्रपति की 'अध्यादेश बनाने की शक्ति' किस अनुच्छेद के तहत है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legislative power when Parliament is NOT in session. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi emergency kanoon chahiye aur Sansad ki chutti chal rahi hai, toh President ordinance nikal sakte hain jo kanoon jaisa hi hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iski validity 6 mahine aur 6 hafte (6 months & 6 weeks) tak hoti hai.

qe: Who administers the 'Oath' (शपथ) to the President of India?
qh: भारत के राष्ट्रपति को 'शपथ' कौन दिलाता है?
o: Chief Justice of India (भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional start of term. \\n2. Logic: Desh ka sabse bada judge (CJI) desh ke sabse bade adhikari ko shapath dilata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Agar CJI na ho, toh Supreme Court ka sabse 'Senior-most' judge ye kaam karta hai.

qe: Under Article 143, the President can seek advice from:
qh: अनुच्छेद 143 के तहत, राष्ट्रपति किससे सलाह ले सकते हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Advisory Jurisdiction. \\n2. Logic: Kisi kanooni uljhan mein President SC se rai maang sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: SC rai dene ke liye majboor nahi hai, aur President us rai ko manne ke liye majboor nahi hain.

qe: What is 'Pocket Veto' of the President?
qh: राष्ट्रपति का 'पॉकेट वीटो' क्या है?
o: Keeping the bill pending indefinitely (विधेयक को अनिश्चित काल के लिए लंबित रखना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Power of Silence. \\n2. Logic: Samvidhan mein koi time-limit nahi hai ki President kab bill sign karega. Wo ise bas apni 'pocket' mein rakh sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: 1986 mein Giani Zail Singh ne Indian Post Office Bill par ise use kiya tha.

qe: The President can declare 'National Emergency' under Article 352 on which grounds?
qh: राष्ट्रपति अनुच्छेद 352 के तहत 'राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल' किन आधारों पर घोषित कर सकते हैं?
o: War, External Aggression or Armed Rebellion (युद्ध, बाहरी आक्रमण या सशस्त्र विद्रोह)
e: 1. Core Concept: Desh ki suraksha. \\n2. Logic: Pehle 'Internal Disturbance' tha, par 44th Amendment ne ise badal kar 'Armed Rebellion' kar diya taaki iska galat use na ho. \\n3. Extra Fact: Emergency lagane ke liye 'Cabinet' ki written advice zaroori hai.

qe: In the election of the President, what is 'Value of Vote' of an MLA?
qh: राष्ट्रपति के चुनाव में, एक विधायक के 'वोट का मूल्य' क्या होता है?
o: Based on State Population / Number of MLAs (राज्य की जनसंख्या के आधार पर)
e: 1. Core Concept: Proportional Representation. \\n2. Logic: Har state ki population alag hai, isliye UP ke MLA ke vote ki value Bihar ya Sikkim se alag hogi taaki sabko barabar weightage mile. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske liye abhi bhi 1971 ki census ka data use hota hai.

qe: Who is the 'Supreme Commander' of the Defense Forces in India?
qh: भारत में रक्षा बलों का 'सर्वोच्च कमांडर' कौन है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Civilian control over military. \\n2. Logic: Military hamesha chune hue head ke niche honi chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: President hi teeno senaon (Army, Navy, Airforce) ke chief ko appoint karte hain.

qe: Can the President return a 'Money Bill' for reconsideration?
qh: क्या राष्ट्रपति 'धन विधेयक' को पुनर्विचार के लिए वापस भेज सकते हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Financial control of Lok Sabha. \\n2. Logic: Money Bill (Art 110) hamesha President ki 'Prior Recommendation' (pehle se li gayi ijazat) se hi pesh hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isliye President ise ya toh sign karte hain ya reject, par 'Reconsider' ke liye wapas nahi bhej sakte.

qe: Under Article 356, the 'President's Rule' is imposed in a State on which ground?
qh: अनुच्छेद 356 के तहत, किसी राज्य में 'राष्ट्रपति शासन' किस आधार पर लगाया जाता है?
o: Failure of Constitutional Machinery (संवैधानिक तंत्र की विफलता)
e: 1. Core Concept: State govt vs Constitution. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi State Govt Samvidhan ke hisab se nahi chal rahi (jaise election ke baad koi sarkar na ban paye), toh Governor ki report par President wahan ka control le lete hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Bihar mein ab tak 8 baar President's Rule lag chuka hai.

qe: What is the maximum 'Gap' between two sessions of Parliament according to Article 85?
qh: अनुच्छेद 85 के अनुसार संसद के दो सत्रों के बीच अधिकतम कितना 'अंतर' हो सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Regularity of Parliament. \\n2. Logic: President session bulata hai (Summon) aur use samapt (Prorogue) karta hai. Do session ke beech 6 mahine se zyada ka gap nahi hona chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska matlab hai ki saal mein kam se kam 2 baar Sansad ki baithak zaroori hai.

qe: The President of India is elected by 'Proportional Representation' through:
qh: भारत के राष्ट्रपति का चुनाव 'आनुपातिक प्रतिनिधित्व' के माध्यम से कैसे होता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Secret Ballot System. \\n2. Logic: Voter (MP/MLA) candidates ko preference (1, 2, 3) dete hain. Agar kisi ko 50% + 1 vote (Quota) mil jaye, toh wo jeet jata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye system isliye hai taaki winner ko 'Absolute Majority' mile.

qe: Who decides the 'Election Disputes' related to the President?
qh: राष्ट्रपति से संबंधित 'चुनाव विवादों' का निर्णय कौन करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Review of Election. \\n2. Logic: Article 71 kehta hai ki agar President ya Vice-President ke election mein koi gadbadi ho, toh sirf SC hi use check karega. \\n3. Extra Fact: SC ka faisla aakhri (final) hota hai.

qe: If the President and Vice-President both are unavailable, who acts as President?
qh: यदि राष्ट्रपति और उपराष्ट्रपति दोनों अनुपलब्ध हों, तो राष्ट्रपति के रूप में कौन कार्य करता है?
o: Chief Justice of India (भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Core Concept: Line of Succession. \\n2. Logic: Desh ka head pad khali nahi reh sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: 1969 mein Justice M. Hidayatullah akele aise CJI the jo Acting President bane.

qe: The President nominates how many members to the 'Rajya Sabha'?
qh: राष्ट्रपति 'राज्यसभा' में कितने सदस्यों को मनोनीत करते हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Merit in Parliament. \\n2. Logic: Art, Science, Literature aur Social Service ke experts ko bina election ke Parliament bheja jata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Pehle 2 Anglo-Indians ko Lok Sabha mein nominate karte the, par ab wo (104th Amendment se) band ho gaya hai.

qe: Which Article says 'There shall be a Council of Ministers with PM to aid and advise the President'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद कहता है कि 'राष्ट्रपति को सहायता और सलाह देने के लिए पीएम के साथ एक मंत्रिपरिषद होगी'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Real vs Nominal Head. \\n2. Logic: President sirf ek 'Nominal Head' (naam ka pramukh) hai. Asli power Cabinet ke paas hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: 42nd Amendment ke baad President Cabinet ki advice manne ke liye majboor (bound) hai.

qe: What is the 'Qualification' age for becoming the President of India?
qh: भारत का राष्ट्रपति बनने के लिए 'योग्यता' आयु क्या है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Eligibility Criteria. \\n2. Logic: Itne bade pad ke liye 'Maturity' zaroori hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske alawa wo Lok Sabha ka member banne ki kabiliyat rakhna chahiye aur 'Office of Profit' par nahi hona chahiye.

qe: The President's 'Veto Power' over State legislation is under which Article?
qh: राज्य विधान पर राष्ट्रपति की 'वीटो शक्ति' किस अनुच्छेद के तहत है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Control over States. \\n2. Logic: Agar Governor kisi State Bill ko President ke liye 'Reserve' kar deta hai, toh President use mana kar sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: State Bill par President 'Pocket Veto' bhi use kar sakte hain.

qe: Under Article 72, what is 'Respite' (विराम) in Pardoning power?
qh: अनुच्छेद 72 के तहत, क्षमादान शक्ति में 'विराम' (Respite) क्या है?
o: Less punishment due to special facts (विशेष तथ्यों के कारण कम सजा)
e: 1. Core Concept: Humanitarian grounds. \\n2. Logic: Agar koi kaidi 'Pregnant' hai ya 'Disabled' (viklang) hai, toh uski saza ko thoda kam ya naram kar diya jata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Commutation' ka matlab hota hai saza ka 'Nature' badalna (Death to Life imprisonment).

qe: The 'Report of CAG' (Comptroller and Auditor General) is submitted to?
qh: CAG की रिपोर्ट किसे सौंपी जाती है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Accountability of Finance. \\n2. Logic: President is report ko 'Parliament' ke dono houses ke samne rakhwate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: CAG ko 'Friend, Philosopher and Guide' of PAC (Public Accounts Committee) kaha jata hai.

qe: Who appoints the 'Attorney General of India'?
qh: भारत के 'महान्यायवादी' (Attorney General) की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legal Advisor to Govt. \\n2. Logic: Attorney General (Art 76) President ke 'Pleasure' (prasad-paryant) tak hi pad par rehte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Wo India ke kisi bhi court mein sunvai kar sakte hain aur Parliament ki proceedings mein baith sakte hain.

qe: Article 111 deals with:
qh: अनुच्छेद 111 किससे संबंधित है?
o: President's Assent to Bills (विधेयकों पर राष्ट्रपति की सहमति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Legislative process end. \\n2. Logic: Jab Sansad bill pass karti hai, toh wo Art 111 ke tehat President ke paas jata hai sign hone. \\n3. Extra Fact: President ke sign ke bina koi bhi bill 'Act' (Kanoon) nahi banta.

qe: The President can declare 'Financial Emergency' under which Article?
qh: राष्ट्रपति किस अनुच्छेद के तहत 'वित्तीय आपातकाल' घोषित कर सकते हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Economic crisis. \\n2. Logic: Agar desh ki financial stability khatre mein ho, toh President salaries kam karne ka order de sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: India mein aaj tak ek baar bhi 'Financial Emergency' nahi lagi hai.

qe: How many times can a person be re-elected as the President of India?
qh: एक व्यक्ति कितनी बार भारत के राष्ट्रपति के रूप में फिर से निर्वाचित हो सकता है?
o: Any number of times (कितनी भी बार)
e: 1. Core Concept: Re-election eligibility. \\n2. Logic: Article 57 kehta hai ki koi bhi insaan jitni baar chahe President ban sakta hai (agar wo chuna jaye). \\n3. Extra Fact: USA mein ek insaan sirf 'Do baar' (2 terms) hi President ban sakta hai.

qe: What is 'Suspensive Veto' (निलंबनकारी वीटो)?
qh: 'निलंबनकारी वीटो' (Suspensive Veto) क्या है?
o: Returning the bill for reconsideration (पुनर्विचार के लिए विधेयक वापस करना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Check on Parliament's haste. \\n2. Logic: President bill wapas bhejte hain, par agar Sansad wahi bill dobara pass kar de, toh President ko sign karna hi padta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye veto 'Money Bill' par use nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: Which Article empowers the President to appoint a Commission for SC/ST?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति को SC/ST के लिए आयोग नियुक्त करने की शक्ति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Protection of Weaker Sections. \\n2. Logic: President hi National Commission for SC aur ST ke members ko appoint karte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: National Commission for OBC (338B) bhi President hi banate hain.

qe: The President's 'Executive Power' includes the appointment of:
qh: राष्ट्रपति की 'कार्यकारी शक्ति' में किसकी नियुक्ति शामिल है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Appointment powers. \\n2. Logic: Desh ke lagbhag sabhi bade constitutional heads President dwara hi appoint kiye jate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: In sabhi ko hatane ka tarika alag-alag hota hai (kuch ko President khud, kuch ko Parliament).

qe: Who addresses the first session of Parliament after each General Election?
qh: प्रत्येक आम चुनाव के बाद संसद के पहले सत्र को कौन संबोधित करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Special Address. \\n2. Logic: Har naye saal ka pehla session aur har election ke baad ka pehla session President ke 'Address' se shuru hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye address 'Cabinet' dwara likha jata hai aur sarkar ki policies batata hai.

qe: Article 60 deals with the 'Oath of the President'. What does he swear to protect?
qh: अनुच्छेद 60 राष्ट्रपति की 'शपथ' से संबंधित है। वह किसकी रक्षा करने की कसम खाता है?
o: The Constitution and the Law (संविधान और कानून)
e: 1. Core Concept: Defender of Constitution. \\n2. Logic: President ki shapath baaki logo se alag hai, wo 'Preserve, Protect and Defend' the Constitution kehte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isi shapath ki wajah se unhe Samvidhan ka rakshak mana jata hai.

qe: The 'Mercy Petition' (दया याचिका) after a death sentence is filed to?
qh: मृत्युदंड के बाद 'दया याचिका' किसके पास दायर की जाती है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Final hope for life. \\n2. Logic: Judiciary ke baad ye Executive (President) ki power hai saza maaf karne ki. \\n3. Extra Fact: Home Ministry is par apni recommendation deti hai, par sign President karte hain.

qe: Which Fundamental Right can NEVER be suspended by the President during Emergency?
qh: आपातकाल के दौरान राष्ट्रपति द्वारा कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार कभी निलंबित नहीं किया जा सकता?
e: 1. Core Concept: Inalienable Rights. \\n2. Logic: 44th Amendment ne pakka kiya ki kisi bhi halat mein 'Jaan' (Life) aur 'Trial' ki suraksha nahi chhini jayegi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 19 sabhi emergency mein suspend nahi hota (Art 358 dekhein).

qe: The Vice-President acts as President when the office is vacant. For how long?
qh: पद खाली होने पर उपराष्ट्रपति राष्ट्रपति के रूप में कार्य करता है। कब तक?
e: 1. Core Concept: Time limit for election. \\n2. Logic: Article 62 kehta hai ki 6 mahine ke andar naya election karwana zaroori hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: USA mein Vice President bache hue poore term ke liye President ban jata hai.

qe: Who was the only President of India elected 'Unopposed'?
qh: निर्विरोध (Unopposed) चुने गए भारत के एकमात्र राष्ट्रपति कौन थे?
e: 1. Core Concept: Historical consensus. \\n2. Logic: 1977 mein unke khilaaf kisi ne parcha nahi bhara (ya radd ho gaya), isliye wo bina election ke jeet gaye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Wo sabse kam umra ke President bhi rahe hain.

qe: Under Article 53, the 'Executive Power' of the Union is vested in?
qh: अनुच्छेद 53 के तहत, संघ की 'कार्यकारी शक्ति' किसमें निहित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Source of Power. \\n2. Logic: Bharat sarkar ka har kaam President ke naam par hi hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Halanki wo ise Cabinet ki advice se hi use karte hain.

qe: Which Article deals with 'Special Address' by the President?
qh: राष्ट्रपति द्वारा 'विशेष संबोधन' से कौन सा अनुच्छेद संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Opening of Parliament. \\n2. Logic: Ye address General Election ke baad aur har saal ke pehle session mein hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Motion of Thanks' (Dhanyavad Prastav) ke baad pass kiya jata hai.

qe: Who appoints the 'Finance Commission' every 5 years?
qh: हर 5 साल में 'वित्त आयोग' की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Tax distribution. \\n2. Logic: Article 280 ke tehat President hi FC banate hain jo Centre aur State ke beech paisa bat-ne ki report deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme ek Chairman aur 4 members hote hain.

qe: The President's resignation is addressed to?
qh: राष्ट्रपति का इस्तीफा किसे संबोधित किया जाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Mutual exchange. \\n2. Logic: President VP ko resign deta hai, aur VP President ko. \\n3. Extra Fact: VP iski suchna turant 'Speaker of Lok Sabha' ko deta hai.

qe: What is 'Pro-tem Speaker'?
qh: 'प्रोटेम स्पीकर' (Pro-tem Speaker) क्या है?
o: Temporary speaker appointed by President (राष्ट्रपति द्वारा नियुक्त अस्थायी अध्यक्ष)
e: 1. Core Concept: Filling the gap. \\n2. Logic: Nayi Lok Sabha ke election ke baad, members ko shapath dilane ke liye President senior-most member ko Pro-tem speaker banate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Jaise hi naya Speaker chuna jata hai, Pro-tem speaker ka pad khatam ho jata hai.

qe: Which Article gives the President power to 'Summon' a Joint Sitting?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति को 'संयुक्त बैठक' बुलाने की शक्ति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Resolving Deadlock. \\n2. Logic: Agar LS aur RS ke beech kisi bill par jhagda ho jaye, toh President dono ko ek sath bulate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iski 'Preside' (adhyakshta) Lok Sabha ka Speaker karta hai, President nahi.

qe: Can the President dissolve the 'Rajya Sabha'?
qh: क्या राष्ट्रपति 'राज्यसभा' को भंग कर सकते हैं?
o: No, it is a permanent body (नहीं, यह एक स्थायी निकाय है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Nature of Houses. \\n2. Logic: Lok Sabha bhang ho sakti hai, par Rajya Sabha kabhi bhang nahi hoti. Iske 1/3 members har 2 saal mein retire hote hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Rajya Sabha ko 'Upper House' ya 'Council of States' kehte hain.

qe: The 'Diplomatic Powers' of the President include:
qh: राष्ट्रपति की 'राजनयिक शक्तियों' में शामिल हैं:
o: Signing International Treaties in his name
e: 1. Core Concept: Foreign relations. \\n2. Logic: Videshi rajdooto ko bulana aur apne rajdooto ko bhejna President ka kaam hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Halanki treaties ke liye Parliament ki approval zaroori hoti hai.

qe: Which Article deals with 'Information to be furnished to the President' by the PM?
qh: पीएम द्वारा राष्ट्रपति को दी जाने वाली जानकारी से कौन सा अनुच्छेद संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Communication Link. \\n2. Logic: PM ka farz hai ki wo Cabinet ke saare faisle President ko batayein. \\n3. Extra Fact: President khud bhi kisi maamle par jankari maang sakte hain.

qe: The President's 'Salary' is charged upon which fund?
qh: राष्ट्रपति का 'वेतन' किस निधि पर भारित होता है?
o: Consolidated Fund of India (भारत की संचित निधि)
e: 1. Core Concept: Financial Security. \\n2. Logic: Iska matlab hai ki unki salary par Parliament mein vote nahi hota, wo hamesha milti rahegi. \\n3. Extra Fact: Filhal President ki salary ₹5 Lakh per month hai.

qe: Can the President be arrested during his term of office?
qh: क्या राष्ट्रपति को उनके कार्यकाल के दौरान गिरफ्तार किया जा सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Criminal Immunity. \\n2. Logic: Article 361 ke tehat President ke khilaaf koi criminal case ya arrest warrant nahi nikala ja sakta jab tak wo pad par hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Civil case ke liye 2 mahine ka 'Notice' dena padta hai.

qe: The first President of India, Dr. Rajendra Prasad, belonged to which state?
qh: भारत के पहले राष्ट्रपति डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद किस राज्य से थे?
e: 1. Core Concept: Bihar Pride. \\n2. Logic: Wo Siwan (Bihar) ke rehne wale the aur sabse lambe samay (12 saal) tak President rahe. \\n3. Extra Fact: Unhe 'Desh Ratna' aur 'Ajatshatru' bhi kaha jata hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Office of the Vice-President'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'उपराष्ट्रपति के पद' का प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Second highest office. \\n2. Logic: Ye pad humne USA se liya hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: VP hi Rajya Sabha ka 'Ex-officio Chairman' hota hai.

qe: What happens if a Bill is reserved by the Governor for President's consideration?
qh: यदि राज्यपाल राष्ट्रपति के विचार के लिए विधेयक सुरक्षित रखता है तो क्या होता है?
o: President can reject or return multiple times (राष्ट्रपति अस्वीकार या बार-बार वापस कर सकते हैं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Unitary bias. \\n2. Logic: State Bills par President ki power Parliament ke bills se zyada hai. Wo ise kitni bhi baar wapas bhej sakte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme Art 201 ka use hota hai.

qe: Who is the only President to use 'Pocket Veto' in India?
qh: भारत में 'पॉकेट वीटो' का उपयोग करने वाले एकमात्र राष्ट्रपति कौन हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Veto history. \\n2. Logic: Unhone Indian Post Office (Amendment) Bill par koi action nahi liya, jisse wo bill khatam ho gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Us waqt Rajiv Gandhi ki sarkar thi.

qe: Which Article of the Constitution says 'There shall be a President of India'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Mandatory Office. \n2. Logic: Union Executive ki shuruat hi Article 52 se hoti hai. \n3. Fact: President desh ka 'First Citizen' hota hai.

qe: Who is NOT a part of the 'Electoral College' for the election of the President?
o: Nominated members of Parliament (संसद के मनोनीत सदस्य)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Sirf 'Elected' log hi vote dete hain. \n2. Hustle: Rajya Sabha ke 12 nominated members aur Vidhan Parishad ke sadasya President ke election mein vote nahi de sakte.

qe: The 'Impeachment' (महाभियोग) of the President is mentioned in which Article?
e: 1. Logic: Article 61 President ko hatane ka ekmatra tarika batata hai. \n2. Ground: Sirf 'Violation of Constitution' ke adhar par hi hataya ja sakta hai. \n3. Fact: Ab tak kisi bhi President par impeachment nahi chala hai.

qe: The President can 'Nominate' how many members to the Rajya Sabha?
e: 1. Logic: Art, Science, Literature aur Social Service ke 12 experts ko President nominate karta hai. \n2. Update: Lok Sabha mein 2 Anglo-Indians ka nomination ab khatam kar diya gaya hai (104th Amendment).

qe: Which Power allows the President to grant 'Pardon' (क्षमादान) to a death sentence?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Article 72 ke tehat President fansi ki saza ko puri tarah maaf kar sakta hai. \n2. Difference: Governor (Art 161) fansi ko puri tarah maaf (Pardon) nahi kar sakta.

qe: The 'Ordinance Making Power' of the President is provided under?
e: 1. Logic: 1-2-3 (President), 2-1-3 (Governor). \n2. Condition: Jab Parliament session mein na ho aur koi emergency kanoon chahiye ho.

qe: Who is the 'Ex-officio' Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
e: 1. Article: 64. VP ka main kaam Rajya Sabha ki adhyakshta karna hi hai. \n2. Fact: VP ko salary Vice-President hone ki nahi, balki Rajya Sabha Chairman hone ki milti hai.

qe: The 'Vice-President' of India is elected by?
o: Electoral College of both Houses (संसद के दोनों सदनों का निर्वाचक मंडल)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: VP ke election mein Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha ke saare (Elected + Nominated) members vote dete hain. \n2. Difference: Isme MLAs vote nahi dete.

qe: If the office of both President and Vice-President is vacant, who acts as President?
o: Chief Justice of India (भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Logic: Order: Prez -> VP -> CJI -> Senior-most Judge of SC. \n2. History: Justice M. Hidayatullah aise pehle CJI the jo Acting President bane.

qe: Under Article 143, the President can seek 'Advice' from?
e: 1. Core Concept: Advisory Jurisdiction. \n2. Logic: President kisi kanooni sawal par SC se rai maang sakta hai. \n3. Bound: Na toh SC rai dene ke liye majboor hai, na President use maanne ke liye.

qe: What is the minimum age to become the 'President' of India?
e: 1. Rule: Prez, VP aur Governor teeno ke liye 35 saal mandatory hai.

qe: Who was the 'First President' of India to die in office?
e: 1. History: Zakir Hussain (Bihar ke purane Governor) office mein hi expired huye the. \n2. Fact: Unke baad V.V. Giri Acting President bane.

qe: The 'Supreme Command' of the Defence Forces of India is vested in?
e: 1. Article: 53(2). President hi teeno senaon (Army, Navy, Airforce) ka Supreme Commander hota hai.

qe: Who among the following was elected 'Unopposed' as President?
e: 1. Fact: 1977 mein Neelam Sanjiva Reddy bina kisi virodh ke chun liye gaye the. \n2. Note: Wo pehle Speaker bhi reh chuke the.

qe: The President's 'Pocket Veto' allows him to keep a bill for how long?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Samvidhan mein koi time limit nahi di gayi hai ki President ko kab tak sign karna hai. \n2. Example: Zail Singh ne Indian Post Office Bill par iska use kiya tha.

qe: Who is the 'Visitor' of all Central Universities in India?
e: 1. Rule: President hi Central Universities ka Visitor hota hai aur VCs ko appoint karta hai.

qe: Article 63 deals with?
o: The Vice-President of India (भारत के उपराष्ट्रपति)
e: 1. Logic: 52 (Prez) -> 63 (VP). \n2. Fact: Bharat mein VP ka pad USA ke Samvidhan se liya gaya hai.

qe: A resolution to remove the 'Vice-President' must be first introduced in?
e: 1. Reason: Chunki VP Rajya Sabha ka Chairman hota hai, isliye use hatane ki prakriya wahin se shuru hoti hai.

qe: Under Article 111, when a Bill is sent to the President, he can return it for reconsideration. This is called?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Agar Parliament fir se wahi bill pass karde, toh President ko sign karna hi padega. \n2. Limit: President 'Money Bill' ko reconsideration ke liye nahi lauta sakta.

qe: Who has the power to declare a 'National Emergency' under Article 352?
e: 1. Condition: President tabhi emergency lagata hai jab Cabinet 'Written' mein sifaarish kare. \n2. Types: Article 352 (National), 356 (State//President Rule), 360 (Financial).

qe: The 'Vice-President' of India can be removed by a resolution passed by?
o: Rajya Sabha with Lok Sabha's agreement (लोकसभा की सहमति से राज्यसभा द्वारा)
e: 1. Process: Rajya Sabha 'Effective Majority' se pass kare aur Lok Sabha use 'Agree' (Simple Majority) kare. \n2. Notice: Iske liye 14 din ka advance notice dena zaroori hai.

qe: Who decides 'Disputes' related to the election of the President and Vice-President?
e: 1. Article: 71. Sirf Supreme Court hi election disputes sun sakta hai. \n2. Fact: Agar election radd (void) ho jaye, toh unke dwara pehle kiye gaye kaam valid rehte hain.

qe: The President of India can 'Pardon' a sentence given by a Court Martial (Military Court).
e: 1. Power: Article 72 President ko military courts ke maamlo mein bhi power deta hai. \n2. Comparison: Governor ke paas ye power nahi hoti.

qe: A 'Money Bill' (धन विधेयक) can be introduced in Lok Sabha ONLY with the prior recommendation of?
e: 1. Financial Power: Bina President ki permission ke Money Bill ya Finance Bill house mein nahi aa sakta. \n2. Logic: Kyunki kharch karne ki power Executive (Prez) ki hai.

qe: Can the Vice-President 'Vote' in the Rajya Sabha in the first instance?
e: 1. Rule: VP Rajya Sabha ka member nahi hota, isliye wo normal vote nahi deta. \n2. Casting Vote: Lekin agar 'Tie' (barabari) ho jaye, toh wo faisla karne ke liye vote deta hai.

qe: Who appoints the 'Attorney General' of India?
e: 1. Logic: Article 76. Desh ka sabse bada law officer President dwara chuna jata hai aur uski marzi (pleasure) tak pad par rehta hai.

qe: The President addresses 'Both Houses' of Parliament together at the start of?
o: First session after each general election (प्रत्येक आम चुनाव के बाद पहला सत्र)
First session of each year (प्रत्येक वर्ष का पहला सत्र)
e: 1. Article: 87. Nayi sarkar banne par aur har saal ke pehle (Budget) session mein President speech deta hai. \n2. Content: Ye sarkar ki policies ka blueprint hota hai.

qe: If the President wants to resign, he addresses his 'Resignation' to?
e: 1. Chain: Prez apna istifa VP ko deta hai, aur VP use turant Lok Sabha Speaker ko inform karta hai. \n2. Vice-versa: VP apna istifa Prez ko deta hai.

qe: Who was the 'First Vice-President' of India?
e: 1. History: Wo lagatar do baar (1952-1962) VP rahe aur baad mein President bane. \n2. Fact: Unke birthday (5 Sept) ko Teachers' Day manaya jata hai.

qe: The 'Contingency Fund of India' (आकस्मिकता निधि) is at the disposal of?
e: 1. Article: 267. Kisi bhi emergency kharche ke liye President is fund se paisa nikalne ki ijazat deta hai (bina Parliament ke wait kiye).

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Election of Vice-President'?
e: 1. Logic: 63 kehta hai ki VP hoga, 66 batata hai election kaise hoga. \n2. Method: Proportional representation with single transferable vote.

qe: The President's 'Diplomatic Powers' include:
o: Signing international treaties (अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संधियों पर हस्ताक्षर)
e: 1. Role: Duniya mein saare samjhote President ke naam par hote hain, bhale hi unhe PM negotiate kare.

qe: Can a person be elected as President more than 'Two Times'?
e: 1. India Rule: Art 57 koi pabandi nahi lagata. Dr. Rajendra Prasad 2 baar chune gaye the, par uske baad ek tradition ban gaya ki koi 2 se zyada baar nahi banega.

qe: Under Article 356, the 'President's Rule' is imposed in a State on the report of?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Jab Governor ko lage ki State Govt Samvidhan ke hisab se nahi chal rahi, toh wo President ko report bhejta hai. \n2. Power: President bina report ke bhi 'President's Rule' laga sakta hai agar wo santusht ho.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Financial Emergency' (वित्तीय आपातकाल)?
e: 1. Logic: Agar desh ki arthvyavastha khatre mein ho, toh President ise laga sakta hai. \n2. Fact: Bharat mein ab tak ek baar bhi Financial Emergency nahi lagi hai.

qe: Who has the power to 'Pardon' a death sentence?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Article 72 vs 161. Governor saza kam kar sakta hai, par fansi ko poori tarah 'Maaf' (Pardon) sirf President hi kar sakta hai. \n2. Scope: Court Martial ki saza bhi sirf President hi maaf karta hai.

qe: The Vice-President can act as President for a maximum period of?
e: 1. Rule: Article 62. President ka pad khali hone par 6 mahine ke andar election hona mandatory hai. \n2. Status: Is beech VP hi Acting President rehta hai.

qe: Who decides the 'Election Petition' related to the President?
e: 1. Article: 71. President aur VP ke election mein koi bhi gadbadi ho, toh sirf SC hi sunvai kar sakta hai. \n2. Note: Unka faisla aakhri (Final) hota hai.

qe: Which Veto power is NOT available to the Indian President?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Qualified Veto USA ke President ke paas hoti hai. \n2. Difference: Isme Parliament ko 'Higher Majority' se bill pass karna padta hai, jabki India mein sirf 'Simple Majority' se Suspensive Veto toot jata hai.

qe: Who appoints the 'Comptroller and Auditor General' (CAG) of India?
e: 1. Article: 148. CAG desh ke khazane ka guard hota hai aur use President hi appoint karta hai. \n2. Security: Ise hatane ka tarika SC judge jaisa kathin hota hai.

qe: The President can summon a 'Joint Sitting' (संयुक्त बैठक) of Parliament under?
e: 1. Condition: Jab Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha mein kisi bill par 'Deadlock' (vivad) ho jaye. \n2. Exception: Money Bill aur Constitution Amendment Bill par Joint Sitting nahi ho sakti.

qe: Which President of India was associated with 'Trade Union' movements?
e: 1. History: V.V. Giri 'All India Trade Union Congress' ke do baar president rahe the. \n2. Fact: Wo desh ke pehle 'Acting President' bhi the.

qe: Who appoints the 'Prime Minister' of India?
e: 1. Article: 75. President us vyakti ko PM appoint karta hai jo Lok Sabha mein 'Majority Leader' ho. \n2. Discretion: Agar kisi ko bahumat na mile, toh President apne vivek se kisi ko mauka de sakta hai.

qe: The 'Resignation' of Vice-President is addressed to?
e: 1. Logic: Prez -> VP ko deta hai, aur VP -> Prez ko deta hai. Dono ek dusre ko resignation dete hain.

qe: Under Article 72, 'Commutation' (लघुकरण) means?
o: Changing the nature of punishment to a lighter form (सजा के स्वरूप को हल्के रूप में बदलना)
Reducing the period without changing nature
e: 1. Example: Fansi (Death sentence) ko 'Umra-kaid' (Life imprisonment) mein badalna 'Commutation' kehlata hai. \n2. Hustle: 'Remission' mein sirf time kam hota hai, nature nahi.

qe: Which President used 'Pocket Veto' for the Indian Post Office (Amendment) Bill?
e: 1. Year: 1986 mein Giani Zail Singh ne bill par na sign kiya na wapas bheja, bas 'Pocket' mein rakh liya. \n2. Reason: Wo bill privacy ke khilaaf tha.

qe: Who is the 'Nominal Head' of the Indian Union?
e: 1. Distinction: President 'De-jure' (naam ke) head hain, par asli power 'De-facto' (PM) ke paas hoti hai. \n2. Analogy: Jaise Britain mein Queen//King hote hain.

qe: A resolution to remove the Vice-President must be supported by how many members for notice?
e: 1. Rule: Rajya Sabha mein kam se kam 20 sadasyo ka support chahiye notice dene ke liye. \n2. Time: 14 din ka advance notice mandatory hai.

qe: Who appoints the 'Finance Commission' (वित्त आयोग) every 5 years?
e: 1. Article: 280. President hi tay karta hai ki Centre aur States ke beech paisa kaise batega.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Re-election' of the President?
e: 1. Fact: Bharat mein ek vyakti kitni bhi baar President ban sakta hai. \n2. Comparison: USA mein max 2 terms allowed hain.

qe: Can the President 'Dissolve' (भंग) the Rajya Sabha?
e: 1. Concept: Rajya Sabha ek 'Permanent House' hai. \n2. Fact: President sirf Lok Sabha ko dissolve kar sakta hai.

qe: The 'Oath' of Vice-President is administered by?
e: 1. Rule: Article 69. President ya uske dwara niyukt koi vyakti VP ko shapath dilata hai.

qe: Who is the 'Guardian' of the Indian Constitution?
e: 1. Logic: Bhale hi President head hai, par Samvidhan ki raksha (Interpret) karne ki asli power SC ke paas hai. \n2. Oath: President shapath leta hai 'To preserve, protect and defend' the Constitution.

qe: How many 'Electoral Votes' are required for a President to win?
o: More than 50% of valid votes (वैध मतों का 50% से अधिक)
e: 1. System: Isse 'Quota' kehte hain. Jab tak 50%+1 vote nahi milte, tab tak winner nahi mana jata.

qe: Who was the 'First Muslim President' of India?
e: 1. Fact: Zakir Hussain 1967 mein President bane the. Unhe Bharat Ratna bhi mila tha.

qe: Can the President be a member of 'Parliament' or 'State Legislature'?
e: 1. Article: 59 (Conditions). Agar koi MP ya MLA President banta hai, toh use apni seat chhodni padegi usi din.

qe: The President's 'Judicial Powers' include the appointment of?
o: Both A and B (A और B दोनों)
e: 1. Logic: Desh ke saare bade judges President dwara hi appoint kiye jate hain (Collegium ki sifaarish par).

qe: Who represents the Government of India in all 'References' made by President to SC?
e: 1. Role: Article 76. AG hi President aur Sarkar ka vakeel hota hai.

qe: Which President had the 'Shortest Tenure'?
e: 1. Reason: Unki death pad par rehte hue ho gayi thi sirf 2 saal ke andar.

qe: The President can issue an 'Ordinance' only when?
o: When either House is not in session (जब कोई भी सदन सत्र में न हो)
e: 1. Condition: Article 123. Ye temporary kanoon hota hai jo 6 hafte tak valid rehta hai Parliament shuru hone ke baad.

qe: Who is the 'Administrative Head' of all Union Territories (without Assembly)?
o: The President (through Administrator) (प्रशासक के माध्यम से राष्ट्रपति)
e: 1. Logic: President hi UTs ka head hota hai aur apne 'Administrators' ya 'LG' ke zariye wahan ka kaam dekhta hai.

qe: The Vice-President of India can hold office for a term of?
e: 1. Tenure: Article 67. Unka term 5 saal hota hai, bhale hi wo Rajya Sabha (6 saal) ko lead karein.

qe: Can the President 'Return' a Money Bill for reconsideration?
e: 1. Rule: Money bill hamesha President ki permission se hi aata hai, isliye wo use wapas nahi bhej sakta. Ya toh sign karega ya rok lega.

qe: Who was the 'First Woman President' of India?
e: 1. History: 2007 mein Pratibha Patil pehli mahila President bani thin. \n2. Update: Droupadi Murmu pehli 'Tribal' mahila President hain.

qe: The President's 'Executive Power' includes the appointment of?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Desh ki saari top constitutional appointments President ke naam par hi hoti hain.

qe: What is the 'Maximum Age' to be the President of India?
e: 1. Fact: Samvidhan sirf 'Minimum' age (35) batata hai, 'Maximum' nahi.

qe: Who is the 'Ex-officio' Chairman of the Indian Red Cross Society?
e: 1. Rule: President hi iska head hota hai.

qe: Which Article allows the President to 'Consult' the Supreme Court?
e: 1. Fact: Ise 'Advisory Jurisdiction' kehte hain.

qe: The Vice-President can cast a 'Casting Vote' in which House?
e: 1. Logic: Chunki wo Rajya Sabha ka Chairman hai, isliye wahin vote dega.

qe: How many 'Nominated Members' are there in the Presidential election?
e: 1. Rule: Nominated members election mein vote nahi de sakte, par 'Impeachment' (hatane) mein part lete hain.

qe: Who was the 'First President' to be elected by 'Second Preference' votes?
e: 1. History: 1969 ke election mein V.V. Giri ko tabhi winner mana gaya jab second preference votes gine gaye.

qe: Is the President of India 'Answerable' to any Court for his official acts?
e: 1. Privilege: Article 361 ke tehat President ko immunity milti hai taaki wo bina dare kaam kar sake.

qe: Who is the 'Chief Executive' of the Union Government?
e: 1. Article: 53. Sangh ki executive power President mein nihit hai.

qe: Can a person be elected as President for a 'Third Term'?
e: 1. Rule: Article 57 kehta hai 'Yes'. Hamare Samvidhan mein koi limit nahi hai.

qe: Who was the 'Longest Serving' President of India?
e: 1. History: Bihar ke Dr. Rajendra Prasad 1950 se 1962 (approx 12 saal) tak President rahe.

qe: Under Article 85, who has the power to 'Prorogue' (सत्रावसान) the Parliament?
e: 1. Power: Session shuru karna aur khatam karna President ka kaam hai.

qe: What is the 'Security Deposit' (जमानत राशि) for the Presidential election?
e: 1. Rule: Candidate ko RBI mein ₹15,000 jama karne hote hain. Agar 1//6th vote nahi mile, toh ye paisa dub jata hai (Zamanat jabt).

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Council of Ministers to aid and advise the President'?
e: 1. Fact: 42nd Amendment ke baad ye 'Advice' President ke liye 'Binding' (manne layak) banadi gayi.

qe: Who was the 'Youngest President' of India?
e: 1. Update: Droupadi Murmu ab tak ki sabse young President hain.

qe: The Vice-President's salary is paid from?
o: Consolidated Fund of India (भारत की संचित निधि)
e: 1. Fact: Ye 'Non-votable' kharch hota hai taaki unki independence bani rahe.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Impeachment' procedure?
e: 1. Flow: Art 61 sabse tough article mana jata hai.

qe: Can the President 'Nominate' members to Lok Sabha today?
e: 1. Update: Anglo-Indian nomination 2020 mein khatam ho gaya hai. Ab Lok Sabha sirf elected members se banti hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Inter-State Council' to promote coordination?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Sarkaria Commission ki sifaarish par 1990 mein ise banaya gaya tha. \n2. Head: Iska Chairman hamesha 'Prime Minister' hota hai. \n3. Purpose: States aur Centre ke beech jhagde suljhana.

qe: Under Article 262, who has the power to adjudicate 'Inter-State Water Disputes'?
e: 1. Hook: Samvidhan ne Parliament ko power di hai ki wo 'Water Tribunal' banaye. \n2. Hustle: Isme SC ya kisi aur court ka jurisdiction nahi hota. \n3. Example: Cauvery ya Krishna water disputes isi ke tehat aate hain.

qe: The 'Residuary Powers' (अवशिष्ट शक्तियां) of legislation are vested in?
e: 1. Article: 248. Jo vishay teeno lists (Union, State, Concurrent) mein nahi hain, unpar kanoon sirf Parliament bana sakti hai. \n2. Source: Ye concept humne 'Canada' se liya hai.

qe: Which Article allows the Parliament to create 'New All India Services'?
e: 1. Power: Agar 'Rajya Sabha' special majority se resolution pass kare, tabhi Parliament naya All India Service (jaise Indian Judicial Service) bana sakti hai.

qe: The 'Seventh Schedule' of the Constitution contains three lists. Where is 'Education' currently placed?
e: 1. History: Pehle ye State List mein tha. \n2. 42nd Amendment (1976) ne ise Concurrent List mein daal diya taaki Centre aur State dono kanoon bana sakein.

qe: If a State Law conflicts with a Union Law on a Concurrent subject, which one prevails?
e: 1. Article: 254. Union Law ko 'Supremacy' milti hai. \n2. Exception: Agar State law ko President ki 'Assent' mil chuki ho, toh wo us state mein valid rahega.

qe: Who can make laws on 'Residuary Subjects' (subjects not in any list)?
e: 1. Article: 248. India mein residuary power Parliament ke paas hai. \n2. Comparison: USA aur Australia mein ye States ke paas hoti hai.

qe: Under Article 249, Parliament can legislate on a 'State List' subject if?
o: Rajya Sabha passes a resolution (राज्यसभा प्रस्ताव पारित करे)
e: 1. Condition: Rajya Sabha ko 2//3rd majority se kehna hoga ki ye 'National Interest' (राष्ट्रीय हित) mein hai. \n2. Tenure: Aisa kanoon 1 saal tak valid rehta hai.

qe: Which Commission was appointed in 2007 to review Centre-State relations?
e: 1. History: Justice Madan Mohan Punchhi ne 2010 mein apni report di thi. \n2. Focus: Governor ka role aur Art 356 ka misuse rokna.

qe: The 'Grant-in-aid' (Article 275) is provided to States by the Centre based on whose recommendation?
e: 1. Logic: Article 280 ke tehat Finance Commission hi tay karta hai ki kis state ko kitne paise ki zaroorat hai.

qe: Can the Centre give 'Directions' to a State under Article 256?
o: Yes, to ensure compliance with Union Laws (हाँ, संघ कानूनों का पालन सुनिश्चित करने के लिए)
e: 1. Power: Agar State nirdesh nahi maanta, toh Art 365 ke tehat wahan President's Rule lagaya ja sakta hai.

qe: The 'Zonal Councils' are established under which Act?
e: 1. Nature: Ye 'Statutory Bodies' hain, Constitutional nahi. \n2. Head: Inka Chairman hamesha 'Union Home Minister' hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Adjudication of Inter-State River Water Disputes'?
e: 1. Power: Parliament kanoon banakar 'Water Tribunal' bana sakti hai. \n2. Restriction: In maamlo mein Supreme Court ka jurisdiction nahi hota.

qe: The 'Full Faith and Credit' clause is mentioned in which Article?
e: 1. Meaning: Ek state ke public acts aur records ko poore India mein maanyata (recognition) milegi.

qe: The 'Sarkaria Commission' (1983) was related to?
e: 1. History: Justice R.S. Sarkaria ne Centre aur States ke beech balance banane ke liye 247 sifaarishein di thin. \n2. Focus: Governor ki appointment aur Article 356 ka kam use.

qe: Under which Article can the Centre give directions to States regarding 'Railways' protection?
e: 1. Power: 257 ke tehat Centre states ko National Importance ki communication aur Railways ki raksha ke liye nirdesh de sakta hai.

qe: The 'GST Council' is a constitutional body under which Article?
e: 1. Logic: 101st Amendment (2016) se ise joda gaya. \n2. Head: Union Finance Minister iska Chairman hota hai.

qe: In which case did the Supreme Court say 'Federalism' is a Basic Structure of the Constitution?
e: 1. Importance: 1994 ke is faisle ne Article 356 ke misuse par rok lagayi aur federalism ko bachaya.

qe: The 'Finance Commission' (Art 280) is appointed for how many years?
e: 1. Rule: Har 5 saal mein President ise banata hai. \n2. Work: Taxes ko Centre aur States ke beech kaise baantein, ye sifaarish karna.

qe: Who has the power to create 'All India Services' (IAS, IPS, IFS)?
e: 1. Article: 312. Agar Rajya Sabha 2//3rd majority se resolution pass kare, tabhi Parliament naya All India Service bana sakti hai. \n2. Logic: Ye states par centre ka control dikhata hai.

qe: The 'Residuary Powers' in India were inspired by which country?
e: 1. Fact: Canada ki tarah humne residuary power Centre (Parliament) ko di hai. \n2. USA: Wahan ye power States ke paas hai.

qe: Article 262 deals with the adjudication of disputes relating to?
e: 1. Power: Parliament 'Water Tribunal' bana sakti hai. \n2. Exclusion: In maamlo mein SC ya HC dakhal nahi de sakte.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Grants-in-aid' from the Union to certain States?
e: 1. Logic: Finance Commission ki sifaarish par ye paisa Consolidated Fund of India se diya jata hai.

qe: Under Article 252, Parliament can make laws for two or more states if?
o: Those States request Parliament (वे राज्य संसद से अनुरोध करें)
e: 1. Rule: Agar do ya zyada states kahein ki humare 'State List' ke vishay par aap kanoon banao, toh Parliament bana sakti hai. \n2. Note: Aisa kanoon sirf unhi states par lagu hoga.

qe: Who is the Chairman of the 'Zonal Councils' in India?
e: 1. Nature: Ye statutory bodies hain (States Reorganisation Act 1956). \n2. Function: Inter-state cooperation ko badhava dena.

qe: The 'Punchhi Commission' (2007) gave its report on which subject?
e: 1. Focus: Isne 'Governor' ke fixed tenure aur President's Rule ko aakhri rasta (last resort) banane ki baat ki.

qe: Who has the power to legislate on subjects mentioned in the 'Concurrent List'?
o: Both Centre and States (केंद्र और राज्य दोनों)
e: 1. Logic: Jaise Education, Forests, Marriage. \n2. Conflict: Agar jhagda ho, toh Union Law (Centre) ki jeet hogi (Art 254).

qe: Under Article 250, Parliament can make laws on 'State List' during which situation?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Hook: 249 mein 'Rajya Sabha' ke resolution par kanoon banta hai, par 250 mein 'Emergency' ki wajah se banta hai. \n2. Tenure: Emergency khatam hone ke 6 mahine baad ye kanoon radd ho jate hain.

qe: Which Article provides that 'English' shall be the language for Centre-State communication?
e: 1. Fact: Samvidhan mein Hindi ko Official language mana gaya hai par communication ke liye English ka option rakha gaya hai.

qe: The 'Punchhi Commission' suggested that the Governor should be appointed for a 'Fixed Tenure' of?
e: 1. Reason: Taaki Centre jab chahe Governor ko hatane ki 'Dhamki' na de sake aur wo nishpaksh kaam kare.

qe: Which Article deals with the 'Financial Relations' between the Union and the States?
e: 1. Division: Legislative (245+), Admin (256+), Financial (268+). Isme Taxes ka distribution hota hai.

qe: Who decides the percentage of 'Net Proceeds' of taxes to be shared with States?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Article 280. 15th FC ne 41% share dene ki sifaarish ki thi (J&K ke alag hone ke baad).

qe: The 'Contingency Fund' of a State is operated by?
e: 1. Analogy: Centre ka President karta hai (Art 267), State ka Governor karta hai.

qe: Can the 'Inter-State Council' give 'Binding' (अनिवार्य) decisions?
o: No, it is only advisory (नहीं, यह केवल सलाहकार है)
e: 1. Nature: Ye sirf raay de sakti hai. Iska faisla Court ke faisle jaisa mandatory nahi hota.

qe: Under Article 258, can the Union 'Entrust' its functions to the State?
o: Yes, with the consent of State Govt (हाँ, राज्य सरकार की सहमति से)
e: 1. Logic: Isse 'Administrative Cooperation' kehte hain. Centre apna koi kaam State ko de sakta hai par unse puch kar.

qe: Which list of the 7th Schedule contains 'Police and Public Order'?
e: 1. Logic: Isliye Bihar Police 'Bihar Sarkar' ke andar aati hai, Delhi Police ki tarah Centre ke nahi. \n2. Note: Delhi Police ek exception hai jo Centre (Home Ministry) ke andar hai.

qe: The 'Sarkaria Commission' (1983) recommended which body to be made permanent?
e: 1. Logic: Article 263 ke tehat coordination ke liye ye zaroori tha. \n2. Fact: 1990 mein V.P. Singh sarkar ne ise banaya.

qe: Who is the Chairman of the 'GST Council'?
e: 1. Article: 279A. Isme Centre ka 1//3rd voting power aur States ka 2//3rd hota hai. \n2. Decision: Kisi bhi faisle ke liye 3//4th majority chahiye.

qe: Under Article 249, Rajya Sabha passes a resolution for State List subject. For how long is it valid?
e: 1. Rule: Ye resolution 1 saal tak valid rehta hai, par ise bar-bar badhaya ja sakta hai.

qe: The 'Residuary Powers' (Art 248) are taken from which Constitution?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Canada mein ye Centre ke paas hain, humne wahi follow kiya. \n2. Logic: Jo kisi list mein nahi, wo Parliament ke paas.

qe: Who decides the 'Inter-State River Water Disputes' under Article 262?
o: Parliament by Law (संसद कानून द्वारा Tribunal बनाकर)
e: 1. Fact: In maamlo mein SC ka jurisdiction bar (roka gaya) hota hai taaki 'Tribunals' jaldi faisla karein.

qe: The 'Punchhi Commission' (2007) was related to?
e: 1. Focus: Isne Governor ke 5 saal ke 'Fixed Tenure' ki sifaarish ki thi.

qe: Under Article 275, 'Statutory Grants' are given to States by?
e: 1. Logic: Finance Commission ki sifaarish par Parliament ye paisa Consolidated Fund of India se deti hai.

qe: Which Article provides for 'All India Services' (IAS, IPS)?
e: 1. Power: Sirf Rajya Sabha hi nayi service (jaise All India Judicial Service) shuru karne ka resolution la sakti hai.
