qe: The 'Administrative Relations' between Centre and State are mentioned in?
e: 1. Division: Legislative (245+), Administrative (256+), Financial (268+).

qe: Who is the Chairman of the 'Zonal Councils'?
e: 1. Nature: Ye 'Statutory Bodies' hain. \n2. Goal: States ke beech sahyog (cooperation) badhana.

qe: Under Article 365, if a State fails to comply with Centre's directions, what can happen?
o: President's Rule can be imposed (राष्ट्रपति शासन लगाया जा सकता है)
e: 1. Logic: Ise 'Constitutional Failure' mana jata hai aur Art 356 ke raste khul jate hain.

qe: Which Article provides that 'Taxes levied and collected by the Union but assigned to the States'?
e: 1. Example: Inter-state trade (CST) ke taxes isme aate hain. \n2. Distribution: Ye sara paisa States ko de diya jata hai.

qe: Who is the 'Ex-officio' Chairman of the National Development Council (NDC)?
e: 1. Role: NDC hi Five Year Plans (purane) ko final approval deti thi. \n2. Fact: Ab NITI Aayog ne iska role le liya hai.

qe: The 'Administrative Relations' between Centre and States are mentioned in which Articles?
e: 1. Division: Legislative (245-255), Administrative (256-263), Financial (268-293).

qe: Can the Parliament legislate on a 'State List' subject to implement an 'International Treaty'?
o: Yes, under Article 253 (हाँ, अनुच्छेद 253 के तहत)
e: 1. Power: Article 253 Parliament ko poori power deta hai ki wo duniya ke kisi samjhote ko poora karne ke liye kanoon banaye, chahe wo vishay State ka hi kyun na ho.

qe: Who was the Chairman of the 'First Finance Commission' of India?
e: 1. History: 1951 mein pehla commission bana tha. \n2. Current: Abhi 16th Finance Commission (Arvind Panagariya) kaam kar raha hai.

qe: The 'Comptroller and Auditor General' (CAG) report on State accounts is submitted to?
o: The Governor of the State (राज्य के राज्यपाल)
e: 1. Logic: Centre ki report President ko, aur State ki report Governor ko jati hai. \n2. Fact: Governor use State Assembly ke samne rakhwata hai.

qe: Which Commission recommended the appointment of 'Governor' to be non-political?
e: 1. History: 1983 mein baine is commission ne Centre-State relations par sabse bada kaam kiya tha. \n2. Focus: Governor ka pad 'Agent of Centre' ban kar na reh jaye, ispar zor diya.

qe: Which Article says that 'State must comply with Union Laws'?
e: 1. Logic: Agar State kanoon nahi manta, toh ise Samvidhan ki vifalta (Failure) mana ja sakta hai.

qe: Under 'National Emergency' (Art 352), which Fundamental Right is NOT suspended?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: 44th Amendment ne pakka kiya ki 'Life' aur 'Protection in conviction' (20//21) kabhi nahi chine jayenge. \n2. Fact: Article 19 sirf tab suspends hota hai jab emergency 'War' ya 'External Aggression' ke adhar par ho.

qe: Which Article allows the President to suspend the 'Right to move any Court' for enforcement of FRs during Emergency?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: 358 sirf Art 19 ko suspend karta hai, par 359 President ko baki rights (except 20, 21) ke liye court jane se rokne ki power deta hai. \n2. Difference: 358 'Automatic' hai, 359 'Presidential Order' par depend karta hai.

qe: The word 'Armed Rebellion' (सशस्त्र विद्रोह) was added to Article 352 by which amendment?
e: 1. History: Pehle 'Internal Disturbance' shabd tha jiska misuse 1975 mein hua. \n2. Logic: 1978 mein Janata Govt ne ise badal kar 'Armed Rebellion' kiya taaki aage koi bina wajah emergency na laga sake.

qe: A proclamation of 'National Emergency' must be approved by Parliament within?
e: 1. Rule: Pehle ye 2 mahine tha, par 44th Amendment ne ise 1 mahina kar diya. \n2. Majority: Dono houses se 'Special Majority' chahiye hoti hai.

qe: Under Article 356, the Parliament's approval for 'President's Rule' is valid for how long?
e: 1. Logic: Ek baar approve hone par ye 6 mahine chalta hai. \n2. Max: Ise badha-badha kar 3 saal tak le jaya ja sakta hai.

qe: Which state in India saw the FIRST imposition of President's Rule (Art 356)?
e: 1. History: 1951 mein Punjab (PEPSU) mein pehli baar ye power use hui thi. \n2. Bihar Fact: Bihar mein pehli baar 1968 mein laga tha.

qe: During a 'Financial Emergency' (Art 360), the President can order the reduction of salaries of?
o: All govt servants including SC//HC Judges (SC//HC जजों सहित सभी सरकारी सेवक)
e: 1. Power: Ye ekmatra aisi situation hai jahan Supreme Court aur High Court ke judges ki salary bhi kam ki ja sakti hai.

qe: Who has the power to 'Revoke' (वापस लेना) the National Emergency at any time?
e: 1. Logic: Iske liye Parliament ki approval nahi chahiye. President jab chahe naya order nikal kar ise khatam kar sakta hai.

qe: Which Amendment allowed the National Emergency to be applied to a 'Part of India' only?
e: 1. Logic: Pehle ye poore desh ke liye tha. 1976 mein niyam badla gaya ki ise kisi specific state ya area tak limit kiya ja sakta hai.

qe: What happens to 'Fundamental Rights' during President's Rule (Art 356)?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Hook: Ye examiner ka favourite trap hai. President's Rule (State Emergency) mein FRs par koi asar nahi padta. \n2. Logic: FRs sirf 'National Emergency' (352) mein suspend hote hain.

qe: If Lok Sabha is dissolved when National Emergency needs approval, what is the process?
o: Rajya Sabha approves it (राज्यसभा इसे मंजूरी देती है)
e: 1. Rule: Rajya Sabha approve kar degi, aur naye Lok Sabha ke baithne ke 30 din ke andar use bhi approve karna hoga.

qe: Which Landmark Case is known as the 'Habeas Corpus Case' during the 1975 Emergency?
o: ADM Jabalpur vs Shivkant Shukla (एडीएम जबलपुर बनाम शिवकांत शुक्ला)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Is case mein SC ne kaha tha ki Emergency mein Life aur Liberty ka haq (Art 21) bhi chhina ja sakta hai. \n2. Note: Justice Khanna ne iske khilaaf akele awaaz uthayi thi. \n3. Update: 44th Amendment ne is faisle ke asar ko khatam kar diya.

qe: Under Article 360, who can 'issue directions' for the reduction of salaries of State employees?
o: The President of India (भारत के राष्ट्रपति)
e: 1. Power: Financial Emergency mein President State Govt ko financial discipline ke nirdesh de sakta hai. \n2. Scope: Isme High Court ke judges ke वेतन bhi shamil hain.

qe: How many times was 'President's Rule' (Art 356) imposed in Bihar till 2026?
e: 1. Bihar History: Pehli baar 1968 mein aur aakhri baar 2005 mein laga tha. \n2. Fact: Bihar un states mein hai jahan iska kafi use hua hai.

qe: What is the maximum period of 'National Emergency' mentioned in the Constitution?
e: 1. Rule: Iski koi 'Upper Limit' nahi hai. Jab tak Parliament har 6 mahine mein ise approve karti rahegi, ye chalta rahega. \n2. Difference: President's rule ki max limit 3 saal hai.

qe: Under Article 359, the President can suspend the enforcement of FRs. Which rights are NEVER suspended?
e: 1. Hook: Ye 44th Amendment ka sabse bada 'Check' hai taaki police kisi ko bina wajah jail mein na daal sake.

qe: If the President's Rule is imposed in a State, who carries on the administration?
o: The Governor (on behalf of President) (राष्ट्रपति की ओर से राज्यपाल)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Council of Ministers bhang ho jati hai aur Governor 'Chief Secretary' ki help se rajya chalata hai.

qe: The proclamation of National Emergency can be challenged in Court on the ground of 'Malafide'?
e: 1. Logic: Judicial Review 'Basic Structure' hai. Agar sarkar galat niyat se emergency lagati hai, toh SC use radd kar sakta hai.

qe: Which Article allows the Centre to take over State control if the State fails to follow Union directions?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Article 356 tab lagta hai jab 'Report' mile, par 365 Centre ko 'Direct Action' ki power deta hai agar State unki baat na maane.

qe: Who was the first Prime Minister to lose power due to an Emergency related election defeat?
e: 1. History: 1977 ke elections mein Indira Gandhi Rae Bareli se haar gayi thin aur pehli baar Non-Congress (Janata Party) sarkar bani.

qe: Which Amendment made the 'Satisfaction of the President' to declare Emergency non-justiciable?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: 1975 mein 38th Amendment ne kaha ki Court President ke faisle par sawal nahi utha sakta. \n2. Correction: 44th Amendment ne ise wapas badla aur 'Judicial Review' ko allow kiya.

qe: Under Article 359, the President can suspend the 'Right to move Court'. Which Article is never touched?
e: 1. Logic: 44th Amendment ne pakka kiya ki Jail se bachne (20) aur Life (21) ka haq kabhi khatam nahi hoga. \n2. Fact: Ye emergency ke dauran 'Life-line' ka kaam karta hai.

qe: How many times has 'National Emergency' (Art 352) been declared in India?
e: 1. History: 1. 1962 (China War), 2. 1971 (Pakistan War), 3. 1975 (Internal Disturbance).

qe: The 'President's Rule' (Art 356) can be extended beyond 1 year ONLY if?
o: EC certifies election difficulty (EC चुनाव कराने में कठिनाई प्रमाणित करे)
Both A and B (A और B दोनों)
e: 1. Rule: 44th Amendment ne limit lagayi ki 1 saal ke baad badhane ke liye ye do shartein zaroori hain. \n2. Max Limit: Phir bhi 3 saal se zyada nahi reh sakta.

qe: During a 'Financial Emergency', can the President reduce the salary of Supreme Court Judges?
e: 1. Exception: Samvidhan mein likha hai ki judges ki salary unke nuksan ke liye badli nahi jayegi, EXCEPT in Financial Emergency (Art 360).

qe: Which Article allows the President to issue an 'Ordinance' during Emergency?
e: 1. Fact: Ordinance making power wahi rehti hai, par Emergency mein President 'State List' ke vishayon par bhi ordinance la sakta hai.

qe: The proclamation of National Emergency must be approved by what Majority?
e: 1. Logic: 44th Amendment ne ise 'Simple' se badal kar 'Special' kiya taaki koi aish-o-aram ke liye emergency na lagaye.

qe: Who was the first Prime Minister to lose an election after Emergency?
e: 1. History: 1977 ke election mein Janata Party jeeti aur Indira Gandhi apni seat bhi haar gayi thin.

qe: Under Article 358, the suspension of Article 19 is restricted to?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Agar emergency 'Armed Rebellion' (3rd type) par lagi hai, toh Art 19 suspend nahi hota. Ye bahut deep point hai.

qe: Can the 'President's Rule' be challenged in a Court of Law?
e: 1. Verdict: S.R. Bommai case (1994) mein SC ne kaha ki hum check karenge ki 'Material' sahi tha ya nahi.

qe: Under Article 358, the suspension of Article 19 freedoms applies to?
e: 1. Rule: Jab poore desh mein emergency ho, toh Art 19 poore desh mein hi khatam mana jata hai.

qe: How many times has 'Financial Emergency' (Art 360) been declared in India?
e: 1. Fact: Bharat mein ab tak ek baar bhi Financial Emergency nahi lagi hai, 1991 ke crisis mein bhi nahi.

qe: The 'President's Rule' (Art 356) can be extended for a maximum period of?
e: 1. Rule: Har 6 mahine mein Parliament ki approval chahiye. \n2. Limit: Max 3 saal tak hi reh sakta hai. Uske baad election karwana hi padega.

qe: Under Article 352, the President can proclaim Emergency ONLY on the written advice of?
e: 1. Hook: Pehle sirf PM ki advice kafi thi (1975 ki tarah). \n2. Update: 44th Amendment ne 'Cabinet' word joda taaki power ka misuse na ho.
